scripts.build:frontend: npm run gen:sdk-types && npm run build:frontend --prefix ../
scripts.build:wasm:fastqc: cd ../wasm-modules/fastqc && cargo build --target wasm32-wasip1 --release && cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/fastqc.wasm ../../src-tauri/resources/wasm/fastqc.wasm
scripts.clean: rm -rf Cargo.lock && rm -rf tsc && rm -rf target && rm -rf gen && rm -rf resources/worker/lia-wasm-runner.worker.js && cargo clean

scripts.build: npm run ts:compile && npm run prodconf && cargo tauri build
scripts.build:dev: npm run ts:compile && npm run devconf && cargo tauri build
scripts.build:local: npm run gen:sdk-types && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:wasm && npm run ts:compile && npm run localdevconf && cargo tauri build
scripts.build:log: npm run ts:compile && npm run prodconf && npm run rustbacktrace && cargo tauri build
scripts.dev:log: npm run ts:compile && npm run devconf && npm run rustbacktrace && cargo tauri dev
scripts.dev:keepsandbox: npm run ts:compile && npm run devconf && npm run keepsandbox && cargo tauri dev
scripts.dev: npm run ts:compile && npm run localdevconf && cargo tauri dev
scripts.dev:local: npm run build:frontend && npm run ts:compile && npm run localdevconf && cargo tauri dev
scripts.dev:clean: npm run clean && npm run dev
scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.build:dev:clean: npm run clean && npm run build:dev
